extracted.summary: The AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to specially-abled students pursuing technical diploma or degree courses at AICTE-approved institutions.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The annual family income from all sources should not exceed INR 8 lakh during the current financial year.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be enrolled in the first year of a diploma or degree program, or the second year via lateral entry
